create_jittable_subclass: create a subclass of Jittable to make a custom object passable as an argument to a JAX jitted function
implement_tree_flatten: implement tree_flatten on a Jittable subclass to split object state into JAX-tracked children and static metadata
implement_tree_unflatten: implement tree_unflatten on a Jittable subclass to reconstruct object state from JAX children and metadata after JIT
check_is_jax_data: check whether a value is a JAX-compatible type using the _is_jax_data helper function
register_pytree_node_class: register a Jittable subclass as a JAX pytree node class so JAX can trace through its attributes
